name: Slick Castalliano
source:
He's the consigliere of the Bellarosa crime syndicate and one third of the powerful trifecta that runs it. A childhood friend of [url=/c176673]Vincenzo[/url] and [url=/c176671]Nick[/url], they have been inseparable ever since. Slick was always the one that was good with numbers in the group. It's never been tested, but it's safe to say that Slick would score off the charts on any IQ test. Slick doesn't shy away from any physical confrontation, which made the trio particularly scary growing up.

[Edited from in-game description]
